name: Mamba-3
capability_it_enables: Improved state-space-model LLM backbone: a more expressive (trapezoidal) recurrence, a complex-valued state-update rule for richer state tracking, and a MIMO formulation that boosts downstream accuracy without increasing decode latency; matches Mamba-2 perplexity with half the state size.
verbatim_quote: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles Through Structured State Space Duality

name: Gated DeltaNet-2
capability_it_enables: Linear-attention sequence layer that decouples erase and write into two independent channel-wise gates, letting the model edit its fixed-size recurrent (compressed KV) memory without scrambling existing associations; trainable on FineWeb-Edu with released code.
verbatim_quote: Linear attention compresses an unbounded KV cache into a fixed-size recurrent state. The hard part is not just what to forget, but how to edit this compressed memory without scrambling existing associations.

name: MiniCPM-SALA
subfield: Efficient sequence architectures / hybrid sparse-linear attention
capability_it_enables: 9B hybrid LLM that interleaves sparse attention (InfLLM-V2) with linear attention (Lightning Attention) at a 1:3 ratio plus hybrid positional encoding, enabling million-token-context inference on consumer GPUs; converts pretrained Transformers to the hybrid via continual training (~75% cheaper than from scratch). Open weights released.
verbatim_quote: Integrates 25% InfLLM-V2 and 75% Lightning Attention, effectively leveraging the granular focus of sparse attention for local details and the high efficiency of linear attention for broad context.

name: Parallax (Parameterized Local Linear Attention)
capability_it_enables: A drop-in upgrade to softmax attention: a scalable, solver-free form of Local Linear Attention that learns a query-like projector probing the KV covariance, with a hardware-aware decode kernel matching/outperforming FlashAttention 2/3; pretrained at 0.6B and 1.7B with consistent perplexity gains.
verbatim_quote: Parallax is an upgrade to Softmax Attention. It is a scalable form of Local Linear Attention (LLA), a mechanism with provable theoretical advantages over Softmax Attention.

name: Reverso
capability_it_enables: A family of tiny (0.2M-2.6M param) zero-shot time-series foundation models that interleave long-convolution and linear-RNN (DeltaNet) layers, matching transformer-based forecasters over 100x larger; pushes the performance-efficiency Pareto frontier. Reverso-Small checkpoint released (others 'coming soon').
verbatim_quote: By combining long convolutions with linear RNN layers, Reverso matches the performance of transformer-based models that are over 100x larger.

name: Toto 2.0
capability_it_enables: An open-weights family of multivariate time-series forecasting foundation models (4M to 2.5B params) trained under one u-muP-scaled recipe, setting state of the art on the BOOM observability benchmark, GIFT-Eval, and the contamination-resistant TIME benchmark; captures multivariate interactions, long context, and cross-domain transfer.
verbatim_quote: Toto is a foundation model for multivariate time series forecasting with a focus on observability metrics.

name: VETime (Vision Enhanced Zero-Shot Time Series Anomaly Detection)
subfield: Time-series foundation models / anomaly detection backbone
capability_it_enables: Zero-shot time-series anomaly-detection backbone that unifies temporal and visual modalities via reversible image conversion, patch-level temporal alignment, anomaly-window contrastive learning, and task-adaptive multi-modal fusion; superior zero-shot localization with lower compute than vision-based baselines. Pretrained checkpoints released.
verbatim_quote: VETime significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models in zero-shot scenarios, achieving superior localization precision with lower computational overhead

name: TimeRadar (Domain-Rotatable Foundation Model for TS Anomaly Detection)
subfield: Time-series foundation models / anomaly detection backbone
capability_it_enables: Generalist zero-shot time-series anomaly detection across unseen datasets via a fractional time-frequency domain: a Fractionally modulated Time-Frequency Reconstruction (FTFRecon) module rotates the series to a learnable fractional order, plus Contextual Deviation Learning for local abnormality; reports avg +10.5% AUC-R and +29.4% AUC-P.
verbatim_quote: TimeRadar is an innovative time series foundation model (TSFM) built in a fractional time-frequency domain to support generalist time series anomaly detection (TSAD) across diverse unseen datasets.
